summary: Read the child-question receipt (CheckRun f418b9d6ab8841faa9ab6c35ce1fcd75): setup event 6 shows the restarted node with an empty live configuration (quorum 1) while its log records one voter, and result event 7 shows it granting both RequestVote and RequestPreVote to a candidate absent from any configuration while adopting the higher term. Recorded that as a witnessed violation with the mechanism and boundaries, added a behavior entry, sharpened the child question's next discriminator, and registered a new parent-linked safety question on whether a stale (smaller) recovered configuration lets a node commit with a quorum that is not a majority of the configuration in force; that consequence experiment is designed but not yet built or executed.
